title: Starter: Scene Loop
summary: A neutral looping scene to copy: a sky over flat ground with placeholder shapes (a grey box, a drifting block, a pulsing marker, a few night motes) across a day and a night phase, with a lofi soundtrack. It draws no subject of its own; its day frame (the first picture) and its night frame pass the lofi frame gate. One knob, horizon (80, 84 or 88; default 84, the golden frames), sets the row where the ground begins.
request: Unknown: the original request was not recorded in the repository. Template from the first kit commits; no request exists. Source description: Hilltop Cabin: a starter scene for pixelate-anything. The cabin, pine and rain were replaced by neutral placeholders in the starter-empty follow-up.

a palette per phase: sky, ground, foreground strip, placeholder box, drifting block, motes and the cycled marker; the day sky stays under L 0.7 so the first picture meets the lofi budget
two placeholder pixel maps: a grey box with a marker centre and a flat drifting block

the engine hooks around a neutral scaffold: sky bands, flat ground, a foreground strip that keeps the bottom third in use, the box, a drifting block, the cycled marker and night motes; the ground row comes from the horizon knob (PIXELATE_KNOBS.horizon)
the generative soundtrack for both phases (day: guitar, night: felt piano), independent of the picture
